conclusion: Neither fixed learned candidate beat the strongest complete-template control on both distance and F1. All 97 new neurons/22 animals were mechanically admitted.

evaluation.aggregation: neuron means within animal; equal mean across22 animals
evaluation.clipping: none; full connected cable and out-of-atlas paths retained
evaluation.distance: frozen symmetric cable distance; same 50 µm representation for all
evaluation.f1: cable F1 within 200 µm, not a fraction of circuits reconstructed
evaluation.inference: Descriptive external transfer; no statistical-significance or population-level confirmation claim.

next_geometry_reference: Use the strongest complete local-medoid control as the development bar; retain all failures and do not tune/retest this cohort as fresh.
observed_comparisons: E1 local animal-balanced medoid is the lowest-distance and highest-F1 method in this fixed set. It selects one measured template from a local soma neighbourhood; it is not a coordinate-average axon.
E4 improves both means over nearest-copy and global-medoid-copy, but loses both means to E1 and E2. This partial improvement does not pass the stronger predeclared comparison.
E6 improves both means over nearest-copy, loses both to E1, and trades higher F1 for worse distance against E2.
scope: Queries used only measured soma and its derived hemisphere; missing molecular labels remain None. No query axon, regional target profile or image features selected donors.
This tests a 3D geometry module. MouseLight lacks measured gene profiles, so it does not validate ModelD or gene-to-circuit inference.

The separately completed PVH image-feature pilot uses real processed fluorescence and has axial sampling/point-spread limitations. It supplies measurements, not traced cells, genes or validated connections.
No complete accurate circuit reconstruction, de-novo connection discovery or prediction viewer promotion was demonstrated.
The 97 neurons / 22 samples are now outcome-exposed. Future method development can use them but cannot describe them as untouched validation.
